# Bilingual Agents

> Bilingual Agents is a placement service that finds vetted, psychologist-screened, bilingual (English/Spanish) remote customer-service, sales and admin agents from Latin America (Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina) for US companies. Your agent is working by day 7 for a one-time flat placement fee, with a 45-day no-questions free replacement on the flagship VETTED tier.

## Pricing
- SOURCE — $1,497 one-time per agent: shortlist of 3–5 vetted candidates in 10 business days; 15-day replacement guarantee.
- VETTED — $1,997 one-time per agent (flagship): adds recorded interviews, licensed-psychologist evaluation report, onboarding kit; shortlist in 7 days; 45-day no-questions free replacement.
- MANAGED — $1,997 one-time + $149/month: everything in VETTED plus a backup candidate on standby, monthly performance check-ins, and anytime free replacement.
- Volume pricing (VETTED): $1,747 per agent at 3 agents, $1,547 at 5, $1,297 at 10+.

## Key facts
- Timeline: 15-minute role call on day 0; shortlist of 3–5 finalists by day 6; your chosen agent working by day 7.
- Guarantee: if the agent doesn't work out within 45 days, Bilingual Agents replaces them free, no questions asked (VETTED tier).
- You employ and pay your agent directly — typically $700–$1,200/month via Wise or Payoneer. Bilingual Agents never touches agent pay and takes no salary markup, ever.
- Screening: live video interviews, English verified live, equipment and internet-speed checks, and a licensed-psychologist evaluation with a written report per finalist.
- Roles placed: customer support, inside sales / SDR, executive assistant, admin and ops.

## Español
> Bilingual Agents coloca agentes remotos bilingües (inglés/español) de América Latina —soporte al cliente, ventas internas y administración— con empresas de Estados Unidos. Tu agente está trabajando para el día 7, con una tarifa fija única por colocación y un reemplazo gratis sin preguntas por 45 días en el plan insignia VETTED.
- Precios: SOURCE $1,497 (entrada) · VETTED $1,997 (insignia, el más elegido) · MANAGED $1,997 + $149/mes. Precios por volumen en VETTED: $1,747 con 3, $1,547 con 5, $1,297 con 10+.
- Tú empleas y le pagas al agente directamente (normalmente $700–$1,200/mes vía Wise o Payoneer); Bilingual Agents nunca toca el salario del agente ni cobra comisión sobre él.
- Evaluación: entrevistas en video en vivo, inglés verificado en vivo, revisión de equipo e internet, e informe de un psicólogo certificado por cada finalista.
- Cómo es diferente de HireLATAM: misma colocación por $1,500 menos (HireLATAM cobra $3,500); tarifa fija en lugar de un porcentaje del salario.
- Puestos: soporte al cliente, ventas internas / SDR, asistente ejecutivo, administración y operaciones.
